message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, red, serif letters dominates the upper section. Below it, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in smaller capitals. The background is a dark red, stylized painting of a man's face with a mustache and a mole on his cheek. A horizontal strip across the middle, styled as a jagged tear, reveals an illustration of a green-domed building with a wide staircase, set against a clear blue sky.

Text in the upper right includes "22-28 DESEMBER 2025," "RP 60.000," and a barcode. Two headlines at the top read "Mobil Listrik Nasional untuk Teman-teman H.78" and "Korporasi Pemicu Banjir Sumatera H.66." 

In the bottom left, large white text reads "MUNIR SAMPAI KAPAN." Beneath it, smaller text states, "Para politikus Senayan mengganjal penyelidikan pembunuhan aktivis hak asasi manusia itu. Komnas HAM terbelah. H.30." The man's face, though partially obscured by the torn paper effect, remains central, with his lips and nose positioned below the building.
